instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide shot, slightly high angle. In a motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls, the man in the black polo and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, kicking his left leg forward. The woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the right, facing him as his foot extends toward her thigh. R1 balances on his right leg while executing the kick. Overhead lights illuminate the space, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
